desc: 硬盒撕开抽取、云纹压花布面、干湿两用的棉柔巾详情页套图
leaf: 硬盒抽取式棉柔巾（一次性云纹压花柔巾，顶部撕拉开孔抽取）
name: 硬盒云纹抽取式棉柔巾款

shots.intent: 用云白展台上的硬盒堆叠与立起的第一张布面，在详情页首屏一眼交代品形与抽取方式。
shots.textZone: eyebrow line plus headline 「{selling_point_1}」 upper-left in #2D2D2D, one marigold pill 「{callout_1}」 beneath it, two white marigold-tab cards 「{callout_2}」 and 「{callout_3}」 down the left margin

shots.intent: 把干用起絮、湿水发软、反复拉扯走形这三类日常挫败放大成一个仰视强视觉，制造继续下滑的动机。
shots.textZone: upper band carries an eyebrow placeholder plus headline 「{selling_point_2}」 and subtitle 「{callout_4}」; three white marigold-tab cards 「{callout_5}」, 「{callout_6}」 and 「{callout_7}」 along the lower edge

shots.intent: 用同一机位同一光四张布面状态卡并列，让买家自行读出耐拉扯、湿用完整、不起絮、不走球四项物理表现。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in the top band; one marigold corner tab per card reading 「{callout_8}」, 「{callout_9}」, 「{callout_10}」 and 「{callout_11}」 at 12pt; no numerals, no badges

shots.intent: 以微距压纹与真实纤维末端替代一切口头柔软承诺，让材质本身成为证据。
shots.textZone: one white marigold-tab card 「{callout_12}」 lower-left and one subtitle placeholder 「{callout_13}」 beside it at 12pt

shots.intent: 用六格场景矩阵把干湿两用的使用面铺满，让不同人群各自对号入座并提升连带。
shots.textZone: one marigold caption bar per tile reading 「{callout_14}」 through 「{callout_19}」 at 12pt, headline 「{selling_point_4}」 in the upper band

shots.intent: 用 90 度侧剖与顶部小俯视图讲清撕拉条与开口抽取机制，回答好不好抽、会不会塌包。
shots.textZone: four markers 「{callout_20}」 to 「{callout_23}」 stepping the crest, tear strip, slit aperture and first-sheet pleat; card eyebrow placeholder plus headline 「{selling_point_5}」

shots.intent: 把单盒与多盒组合排成阶梯，让买家一步完成规格选择并抬高客单。
shots.textZone: one marigold tab card beneath each group reading 「{callout_24}」 at 12pt, short upper-band line 「{selling_point_6}」 at 20pt

shots.intent: 用深蓝信息带与四个单线图标把放心感落到可复核的图形证据位上，收尾理性说服。
shots.textZone: band headline 「{selling_point_7}」 in #FCFDFE at 34pt with one subtitle placeholder 「{callout_25}」 at 14pt; four line-icon captions 「{callout_26}」 to 「{callout_29}」 at 12pt

shots.intent: 以仰视气势与一条收口主张加一个按钮形状结束详情页，承接加购决策。
shots.textZone: marine band carries one marigold CTA pill 「{callout_30}」 at 18pt and a supporting line 「{callout_31}」 at 12pt, plus one closing headline 「{selling_point_8}」 at 30pt; no QR, no price

style.backgroundSystem: seamless powder-blue painted cyclorama #D9E7F5 with flat rounded arch backdrop shapes in #C7DDF2 and a brighter low horizon in cloud white #FCFDFE; one deep marine closing band #1D4E85 reserved for the trust and promo screens; no photographic scenery, no cut-out backdrops, no gradient mesh
style.direction: airy cloud-white nursery paper-goods commerce, cool powder-blue soft-towel commerce
style.iconSystem: flat white rounded-rectangle cards each carrying exactly one marigold #F6A62B corner tab with a short label, plus thin dotted arc trajectory lines as the only connector device; on the marine screens, thin single-weight white line icons inside outlined circles; no filled illustration, no microbe or germ doodles, no 3D icons, no floating spheres or bubble discs
style.lightingSystem: large soft cool key from camera-upper-right at about 6500K, broad even wrap around the carton edges, one thin bright rim tracing the crest of the drawn sheet, soft contact shadows only, never hard specular, never a warm cream bounce, never an upper-left key
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy cloud-white nursery paper-goods commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of powder-blue studio field #D9E7F5, cloud-white plinth and low horizon #FCFDFE, deep marine closing band #1D4E85, deep charcoal type #2D2D2D, and one marigold accent #F6A62B; cool tone held on every screen; one modern geometric sans-serif family with a letter-spaced uppercase eyebrow, bold Chinese headline, light subtitle and small marigold-tab captions, hierarchy identical everywhere; seamless painted cyclorama with flat rounded arch backdrop shapes in #C7DDF2, no photographic scenery and no gradient mesh; large soft cool key from camera-upper-right at about 6500K with a broad even wrap, one thin bright rim on the crest of the drawn sheet and soft contact shadows only, never hard specular and never a warm cream bounce; matte painted plinth and pale matte counter, one matte ceramic basin rim, raw cotton bolls on short husk stems in #C08A57 as the only tactile props; layout uses flat white rounded-rectangle cards with exactly one marigold corner tab each, thin dotted arc trajectory lines as the only connector, and thin single-weight white line icons inside outlined circles on the marine screens, no filled illustration, no microbe doodles, no 3D icons, no floating spheres; product presented as a rigid rectangular carton with a scalloped cloud crest along the top seam, a slit pull-out aperture on the top face and a pale floral printed field, its drawn sheet always embossed non-woven plant-fibre cloth with a visible ripple emboss, never smooth paper towel and never looped terry, front label zone kept as a blank legible field, stable carton scale and upright centring, never floating without a contact shadow; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented certifications, readings, counts or measurements.
noDrift: no warm cream or sage-green studio cast, no front-left key light, no 5200K daylight-look mood

style.presentationRules: product always a rigid rectangular carton with a scalloped cloud crest along the top seam, a slit pull-out aperture on the top face and a pale floral printed field; the drawn sheet is always embossed non-woven plant-fibre cloth with a visible ripple emboss, never smooth paper towel and never looped terry; carton scale and upright centring stable across screens; front label zone kept as a blank legible field for post-composited copy; colour taken from the reference and never re-tinted; never floating without a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: matte painted cloud-crest plinth and pale matte counter in #FCFDFE, one matte ceramic basin rim in #FCFDFE, raw cotton bolls on short husk stems in #C08A57 as the only tactile props; nothing glossy, chrome or clinical
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; letter-spaced uppercase eyebrow line, bold Chinese headline in #2D2D2D, light subtitle, small captions set inside marigold tabs; sizes and hierarchy identical across the whole set
